column1: # The listing parses of prompt-hook.rows-cause in hook-latency.txt, one fresh process per row.
# Machine: Intel Xeon Processor, CPU family 6 model 207, 8 CPUs, 1 socket of 8 cores, 1 thread per core.
# The machine has an L3 of 320 MiB and 47 GiB of memory, under Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) full virtualization, on Linux 6.12.94+.
# Pinning: none; no CPU affinity was set, the guest exposes no frequency governor, and nothing else ran during the draws.
# Parser: a scratch binary on serde_json 1.0.151 (preserve_order, raw_value) and serde 1, built in release with line tables only.
# Listing: the 6859107-byte listing of 10000 claims that a warm prompt hook kept on disk.
# That listing is the one of the 10000-claim pack of hook-scale-draws.tsv.
# Form map parses the whole document into serde_json::Value.
# Form row parses the claims into the 19 fields of the hook's Row (crates/ljos-cli/src/lib.rs), each kept as the listing gave it.
# Order: 12 of each form, shuffled by random.SystemRandom.
# read_ms: reading the file into a string; parse_ms: the parse alone; both by std::time::Instant.
